;consis:
Your consistency must be 15% or less to request a withdrawal.
You achieve 15% consistency when your highest profit day represents no more than 15% of your total profit.

To find the required total profit:
Highest profit day divided by 0.15 equals required total profit.

You must also ensure that no other day’s profit exceeds your highest profit day.

Example:
If your highest profit in a single day is $50:
50 divided by 0.15 equals $333.33.

Your total profit must reach $333.33 or more.
Every other day’s profit must remain below $50.

Traders cannot open or close trades two minutes before or after a Red Folder news event release.

This includes:
Trades hitting take profit (TP) or profit target.
Pending orders being triggered.

Trades that were already open before the news event but close within the restricted time window.

If any trades are executed during this period and result in passing an evaluation, the account will not be considered as having passed the challenge.
We have an auto-close feature that closes trades once the profit target is reached. If your trade is automatically closed during a restricted news period, even with a TP set, it will be counted as a violation. Traders who pass based on news trades will not pass the challenge.
The same rule applies to Live Accounts. Any profits made from trades executed within the restricted news window will not be credited.
;profit:
To pass your account, one of the required criteria is achieving a minimum number of profitable trading days.

• For 1-Step & 2-Step Accounts:
You must achieve at least **3 profitable trading days**, with a minimum profit of **0.25% of the account balance per day**.

• For 3-Step Accounts:
You must achieve **3 profitable trading days**, with a minimum profit of **0.1% of the account balance per day**.

• For Payouts & Live Accounts:
Traders must continue to follow the same minimum trading day rules based on their respective account type in order to request a withdrawal.
After each payout, the minimum trading days requirement **resets** and must be achieved again for future payouts.

• Trading Day Definition:
All trading days are calculated based on the **5:00 PM EST timezone**.
We strongly advise traders to rely on their **dashboard** for all account data rather than the MatchTrader platform.
A trading day is always determined by **5 PM EST**, regardless of your local timezone.

• Instant Accounts:
Instant accounts require **5 profitable trading days**, with a minimum profit of **0.5% of the account balance per day**.

Instant Funding Accounts & $XK for $X Accounts:

Yes, Next Level Funded enforces a **20% Consistency Rule** for Instant Funding Accounts to promote disciplined and sustainable trading.

How it works:
Your most profitable trading day must not exceed **20% of your total profits** at the time you request a payout.
If your largest winning day accounts for more than 20% of your overall profits, your payout will be deferred until the account returns to compliance.

This rule is designed to discourage high-risk, unsustainable trading behavior and support long-term performance.

Basic 1 & 2-Step Challenge Accounts:

No, there is **no consistency rule** applied to 1 & 2-Step Challenge accounts.
Traders may trade freely as long as they follow core trading guidelines, including:

• A minimum of 3 trading days to complete the evaluation
• Avoidance of prohibited strategies such as gambling, excessive scalping/HFT, or martingale-style systems

Our goal is to maintain a fair and transparent trading environment while allowing skilled traders to perform with minimal restrictions.
